learning_data.name: What is Spelling
learning_data.info: Spelling is the act of writing or naming the letters that show up within a word. There are many words in the english dictionary, and each use different combinations in order to create words.

learning_data.name: The Purpose of spelling
learning_data.info: By written or verbal audio of a given word, we as humans can identify how to spell that word just based on the sound that each letter in the alphabet has.

learning_data.name: Remember
learning_data.info: Remember that you should try to recount the alphabet, follow the words carefully and try and grasp the spelling based off of that.
